426: static uint16_t network_ping_checksum(const void *buffer, size_t length)
427: {
428:   const uint16_t *word = buffer;
429:   uint32_t sum = 0;
430: 
431:   while (length > 1)
432:     {
433:       sum += *word++;
434:       length -= 2;
435:     }
436: 
437:   if (length != 0)
438:     {
439:       sum += *(const uint8_t *)word;
440:     }
441: 
442:   while ((sum >> 16) != 0)
443:     {
444:       sum = (sum & 0xffff) + (sum >> 16);
445:     }
446: 
447:   return (uint16_t)~sum;
448: }

494:   if (server->sin_port == 0)
495:     {
496:       server->sin_port = htons(DNS_DEFAULT_PORT);
497:     }
498: 
499:   return true;

516: static bool network_dns_skip_name(const uint8_t *message, size_t length,
517:                                   size_t *offset)
518: {
519:   while (*offset < length)
520:     {
521:       uint8_t label_length = message[(*offset)++];
522: 
523:       if (label_length == 0)
524:         {
525:           return true;
526:         }
527: 
528:       if ((label_length & 0xc0) == 0xc0)
529:         {
530:           if (*offset >= length)
531:             {
532:               return false;
533:             }
534: 
535:           (*offset)++;
536:           return true;
537:         }
538: 
539:       if (label_length > 63 || *offset + label_length > length)
540:         {
541:           return false;
542:         }
543: 
544:       *offset += label_length;
545:     }
546: 
547:   return false;
548: }

550: static bool network_resolve_host(const char *hostname,
551:                                  struct in_addr *resolved_address)
552: {
553:   struct sockaddr_in dns_server;
554:   uint8_t query[NETWORK_DNS_BUFFER_SIZE];
555:   uint8_t response[NETWORK_DNS_BUFFER_SIZE];
556:   struct dns_header_s *header = (struct dns_header_s *)query;
557:   const char *label = hostname;
558:   uint16_t query_id = ++g_network_dns_id;
559:   if (query_id == 0)
560:     {
561:       query_id = ++g_network_dns_id;
562:     }
563:   size_t query_length = sizeof(struct dns_header_s);
564:   unsigned int poll_count;
565:   int sockfd;
566:   int ret;
567: 
568:   if (!network_get_dns_server(&dns_server))
569:     {
570:       syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s dns-server=missing\n",
571:              hostname);
572:       return false;
573:     }
574: 
575:   memset(query, 0, sizeof(query));
576:   header->id = htons(query_id);
577:   header->flags1 = DNS_FLAG1_RD;
578:   header->numquestions = htons(1);
579: 
580:   while (*label != '\0')
581:     {
582:       const char *dot = strchr(label, '.');
583:       size_t label_length = dot == NULL ? strlen(label) :
584:                                           (size_t)(dot - label);
585: 
586:       if (label_length == 0 || label_length > 63 ||
587:           query_length + label_length + 6 > sizeof(query))
588:         {
589:           return false;
590:         }
591: 
592:       query[query_length++] = (uint8_t)label_length;
593:       memcpy(&query[query_length], label, label_length);
594:       query_length += label_length;
595:       if (dot == NULL)
596:         {
597:           break;
598:         }
599: 
600:       label = dot + 1;
601:     }
602: 
603:   query[query_length++] = 0;
604:   network_dns_write_u16(&query[query_length], DNS_RECTYPE_A);
605:   query_length += 2;
606:   network_dns_write_u16(&query[query_length], DNS_CLASS_IN);
607:   query_length += 2;
608: 
609:   sockfd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, IPPROTO_UDP);
610:   if (sockfd < 0)
611:     {
612:       syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s dns-socket=%d\n",
613:              hostname, errno);
614:       return false;
615:     }
616: 
617:   if (fcntl(sockfd, F_SETFL, O_NONBLOCK) < 0)
618:     {
619:       syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s dns-nonblock=%d\n",
620:              hostname, errno);
621:       close(sockfd);
622:       return false;
623:     }
624: 
625:   ret = sendto(sockfd, query, query_length, MSG_DONTWAIT,
626:                (const struct sockaddr *)&dns_server,
627:                sizeof(dns_server));
628:   if (ret != (int)query_length)
629:     {
630:       syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s dns-send=%d errno=%d\n",
631:              hostname, ret, errno);
632:       close(sockfd);
633:       return false;
634:     }
635: 
636:   for (poll_count = 0; poll_count < NETWORK_PING_POLLS; poll_count++)
637:     {
638:       ssize_t received;
639: 
640:       received = recvfrom(sockfd, response, sizeof(response),
641:                           MSG_DONTWAIT, NULL, NULL);
642:       if (received >= (ssize_t)sizeof(struct dns_header_s))
643:         {
644:           struct dns_header_s *response_header =
645:             (struct dns_header_s *)response;
646:           size_t offset = sizeof(struct dns_header_s);
647:           unsigned int index;
648: 
649:           if (ntohs(response_header->id) != query_id ||
650:               (response_header->flags1 & DNS_FLAG1_RESPONSE) == 0 ||
651:               (response_header->flags2 & DNS_FLAG2_ERR_MASK) != 0)
652:             {
653:               continue;
654:             }
655: 
656:           for (index = 0;
657:                index < ntohs(response_header->numquestions); index++)
658:             {
659:               if (!network_dns_skip_name(response, received, &offset) ||
660:                   offset + 4 > (size_t)received)
661:                 {
662:                   break;
663:                 }
664: 
665:               offset += 4;
666:             }
667: 
668:           for (index = 0; index < ntohs(response_header->numanswers);
669:                index++)
670:             {
671:               uint16_t record_type;
672:               uint16_t record_class;
673:               uint16_t record_length;
674: 
675:               if (!network_dns_skip_name(response, received, &offset) ||
676:                   offset + 10 > (size_t)received)
677:                 {
678:                   break;
679:                 }
680: 
681:               record_type = network_dns_read_u16(&response[offset]);
682:               record_class = network_dns_read_u16(&response[offset + 2]);
683:               record_length = network_dns_read_u16(&response[offset + 8]);
684:               offset += 10;
685:               if (offset + record_length > (size_t)received)
686:                 {
687:                   break;
688:                 }
689: 
690:               if (record_type == DNS_RECTYPE_A &&
691:                   record_class == DNS_CLASS_IN && record_length == 4)
692:                 {
693:                   memcpy(resolved_address, &response[offset], 4);
694:                   close(sockfd);
695:                   return true;
696:                 }
697: 
698:               offset += record_length;
699:             }
700:         }
701:       else if (received < 0 && errno != EAGAIN && errno != EWOULDBLOCK &&
702:                errno != EINTR)
703:         {
704:           syslog(LOG_WARNING,
705:                  "[HOME][NET] host=%s dns-recv=%d\n", hostname, errno);
706:           break;
707:         }
708: 
709:       usleep(NETWORK_PING_POLL_US);
710:     }
711: 
712:   syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s dns-timeout\n", hostname);
713:   close(sockfd);
714:   return false;
715: }

717: static int network_ping_host(const char *hostname)
718: {
719:   struct network_ping_packet_s packet;
720:   struct sockaddr_in destination;
721:   uint8_t receive_buffer[64];
722:   uint16_t ping_id;
723:   unsigned int poll_count;
724:   int sockfd;
725:   int ret;
726: 
727:   memset(&destination, 0, sizeof(destination));
728:   destination.sin_family = AF_INET;
729:   if (!network_resolve_host(hostname, &destination.sin_addr))
730:     {
731:       return 0;
732:     }
733: 
734:   sockfd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_RAW, IPPROTO_ICMP);
735:   if (sockfd < 0)
736:     {
737:       syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s socket=%d\n",
738:              hostname, errno);
739:       return 0;
740:     }
741: 
742:   if (fcntl(sockfd, F_SETFL, O_NONBLOCK) < 0)
743:     {
744:       syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s nonblock=%d\n",
745:              hostname, errno);
746:       close(sockfd);
747:       return 0;
748:     }
749: 
750:   memset(&packet, 0, sizeof(packet));
751:   ping_id = ++g_network_ping_id;
752:   if (ping_id == 0)
753:     {
754:       ping_id = ++g_network_ping_id;
755:     }
756: 
757:   packet.header.type = ICMP_ECHO_REQUEST;
758:   packet.header.id = htons(ping_id);
759:   packet.header.seqno = htons(1);
760:   memset(packet.data, 0x5a, sizeof(packet.data));
761:   packet.header.icmpchksum = network_ping_checksum(&packet,
762:                                                    sizeof(packet));
763: 
764:   ret = sendto(sockfd, &packet, sizeof(packet), MSG_DONTWAIT,
765:                (const struct sockaddr *)&destination,
766:                sizeof(destination));
767:   if (ret != (int)sizeof(packet))
768:     {
769:       syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s send=%d errno=%d\n",
770:              hostname, ret, errno);
771:       close(sockfd);
772:       return 0;
773:     }
774: 
775:   for (poll_count = 0; poll_count < NETWORK_PING_POLLS; poll_count++)
776:     {
777:       ssize_t received;
778:       size_t offset = 0;
779:       struct icmp_hdr_s *reply;
780: 
781:       received = recvfrom(sockfd, receive_buffer, sizeof(receive_buffer),
782:                           MSG_DONTWAIT, NULL, NULL);
783:       if (received > 0)
784:         {
785:           if ((receive_buffer[0] >> 4) == 4)
786:             {
787:               offset = (receive_buffer[0] & 0x0f) * 4;
788:             }
789: 
790:           if ((size_t)received >= offset + sizeof(struct icmp_hdr_s))
791:             {
792:               reply = (struct icmp_hdr_s *)(receive_buffer + offset);
793:               if (reply->type == ICMP_ECHO_REPLY &&
794:                   ntohs(reply->id) == ping_id &&
795:                   ntohs(reply->seqno) == 1)
796:                 {
797:                   close(sockfd);
798:                   return 1;
799:                 }
800:             }
801:         }
802:       else if (errno != EAGAIN && errno != EWOULDBLOCK && errno != EINTR)
803:         {
804:           syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s recv=%d\n",
805:                  hostname, errno);
806:           break;
807:         }
808: 
809:       usleep(NETWORK_PING_POLL_US);
810:     }
811: 
812:   close(sockfd);
813:   return 0;
814: }

816: static void *network_worker(void *arg)
817: {
818:   unsigned int elapsed = NETWORK_PROBE_INTERVAL;
819:   unsigned int initial_down_seconds = 0;
820:   bool was_connected = false;
821:   bool link_seen = false;
822:   enum network_link_state_e last_link = NETWORK_LINK_INITIALIZING;
823:   uint8_t last_flags = UINT8_MAX;
824: 
825:   (void)arg;
826: 
827:   for (;;)
828:     {
829:       uint8_t flags;
830:       enum network_link_state_e link = network_get_link_state(&flags);
831:       bool connected = link == NETWORK_LINK_UP;
832:       bool refresh = g_network_refresh_requested;
833:       struct in_addr address;
834: 
835:       if (link != last_link || flags != last_flags)
836:         {
837:           const char *link_name = link == NETWORK_LINK_UP ? "up" :
838:                                   link == NETWORK_LINK_DOWN ? "down" :
839:                                   "initializing";
840: 
841:           syslog(LOG_INFO, "[HOME][NET] carrier=%s flags=%02x\n",
842:                  link_name, flags);
843:           last_link = link;
844:           last_flags = flags;
845:         }
846: 
847:       g_network_refresh_requested = false;
848:       if (link == NETWORK_LINK_INITIALIZING)
849:         {
850:           network_set_state(NETWORK_INITIALIZING);
851:           was_connected = false;
852:           elapsed = NETWORK_PROBE_INTERVAL;
853:           initial_down_seconds = 0;
854:         }
855:       else if (!connected)
856:         {
857:           if (!link_seen && initial_down_seconds < NETWORK_LINK_GRACE_SEC)
858:             {
859:               network_set_state(NETWORK_INITIALIZING);
860:               initial_down_seconds++;
861:             }
862:           else
863:             {
864:               network_set_state(NETWORK_DISCONNECTED);
865:             }
866:           was_connected = false;
867:           elapsed = NETWORK_PROBE_INTERVAL;
868:         }
869:       else if (!network_get_ipv4_address(&address))
870:         {
871:           /* DHCP runs independently. Keep checking without reporting a
872:            * false Internet failure while an address is being acquired.
873:            */
874: 
875:           network_set_state(NETWORK_CHECKING);
876:           link_seen = true;
877:           initial_down_seconds = 0;
878:           was_connected = false;
879:         }
880:       else if (!was_connected || refresh ||
881:                elapsed >= NETWORK_PROBE_INTERVAL)
882:         {
883:           int replies;
884:           char address_text[INET_ADDRSTRLEN];
885: 
886:           /* Keep the last definitive result visible during an automatic
887:            * background probe.  Only initial and user-requested probes show
888:            * the transient checking state.
889:            */
890: 
891:           if (!was_connected || refresh)
892:             {
893:               network_set_state(NETWORK_CHECKING);
894:             }
895:           link_seen = true;
896:           initial_down_seconds = 0;
897:           inet_ntop(AF_INET, &address, address_text, sizeof(address_text));
898:           replies = network_ping_host("mi.com");
899:           if (replies <= 0 && network_has_carrier())
900:             {
901:               replies = network_ping_host("xiaomi.cn");
902:             }
903: 
904:           if (!network_has_carrier())
905:             {
906:               network_set_state(NETWORK_DISCONNECTED);
907:             }
908:           else
909:             {
910:               network_set_state(replies > 0 ? NETWORK_ONLINE :
911:                                               NETWORK_NO_INTERNET);
912:               syslog(LOG_INFO,
913:                      "[HOME][NET] health ipv4=%s result=%s\n",
914:                      address_text, replies > 0 ? "online" : "unreachable");
915:             }
916: 
917:           was_connected = true;
918:           elapsed = 0;
919:         }
920:       else
921:         {
922:           elapsed++;
923:         }
924: 
925:       sleep(1);
926:     }
927: 
928:   return NULL;
929: }

931: static int start_network_monitor(void)
932: {
933:   pthread_attr_t attr;
934:   struct sched_param param;
935:   pthread_t thread;
936:   int ret;
937: 
938:   ret = pthread_attr_init(&attr);
939:   if (ret != 0)
940:     {
941:       return ret;
942:     }
943: 
944:   pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attr, NETWORK_THREAD_STACK);
945:   pthread_attr_setdetachstate(&attr, PTHREAD_CREATE_DETACHED);
946:   memset(&param, 0, sizeof(param));
947:   param.sched_priority = NETWORK_THREAD_PRIORITY;
948:   pthread_attr_setschedparam(&attr, &param);
949:   pthread_attr_setinheritsched(&attr, PTHREAD_EXPLICIT_SCHED);
950:   ret = pthread_create(&thread, &attr, network_worker, NULL);
951:   pthread_attr_destroy(&attr);
952:   return ret;
953: }

1137: 
1138:       lv_obj_remove_flag(g_login_qr, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
1139:       lv_obj_invalidate(g_login_qr);
1140:       return true;
1141:     }
1142: 
1143:   data = malloc(snapshot->qr_size);
1144:   if (data == NULL)
1145:     {
1146:       return false;
1147:     }
1148: 
1149:   ret = home_panel_mijia_copy_qr(snapshot->qr_revision, data,
1150:                                  snapshot->qr_size, &size);
1151:   if (ret < 0)
1152:     {
1153:       free(data);
1154:       return false;
1155:     }
1156: 
1157:   if (g_login_qr_data != NULL)
1158:     {
1159:       lv_image_cache_drop(&g_login_qr_image);
1160:       lv_image_set_src(g_login_qr, NULL);
1161:       free(g_login_qr_data);
1162:     }
1163: 
1164:   memset(&g_login_qr_image, 0, sizeof(g_login_qr_image));
1165:   g_login_qr_data = data;
1166:   g_login_qr_revision = snapshot->qr_revision;
1167:   g_login_qr_image.header.magic = LV_IMAGE_HEADER_MAGIC;
1168:   g_login_qr_image.header.cf = LV_COLOR_FORMAT_RGB565;
1169:   g_login_qr_image.header.w = 240;
1170:   g_login_qr_image.header.h = 240;
1171:   g_login_qr_image.header.stride = 480;
1172:   g_login_qr_image.data_size = size;
1173:   g_login_qr_image.data = data;
1174: 
1175:   memset(&header, 0, sizeof(header));
1176:   if (lv_image_decoder_get_info(&g_login_qr_image, &header) !=
1177:       LV_RESULT_OK || header.cf != LV_COLOR_FORMAT_RGB565 ||
1178:       header.w != 240 || header.h != 240 || header.stride != 480)
1179:     {
1180:       syslog(LOG_ERR,
1181:              "[HOME][UI] qr decoder rejected descriptor cf=%u %ux%u stride=%u\n",
1182:              (unsigned int)header.cf, (unsigned int)header.w,
1183:              (unsigned int)header.h, (unsigned int)header.stride);
1184:       free(g_login_qr_data);
1185:       g_login_qr_data = NULL;
1186:       g_login_qr_revision = 0;
1187:       memset(&g_login_qr_image, 0, sizeof(g_login_qr_image));
1188:       return false;
1189:     }
1190: 
1191:   for (offset = 0; offset + 1 < size; offset += 2)
1192:     {
1193:       if (data[offset] == 0 && data[offset + 1] == 0)
1194:         {
1195:           dark_pixels++;
1196:         }
1197:     }
1198: 
1199:   lv_image_set_src(g_login_qr, &g_login_qr_image);
1200:   if (lv_image_get_src(g_login_qr) != &g_login_qr_image)
1201:     {
1202:       syslog(LOG_ERR, "[HOME][UI] qr source rejected after decode\n");
1203:       free(g_login_qr_data);
1204:       g_login_qr_data = NULL;
1205:       g_login_qr_revision = 0;
1206:       memset(&g_login_qr_image, 0, sizeof(g_login_qr_image));
1207:       return false;
1208:     }
1209: 
1210:   lv_obj_remove_flag(g_login_qr, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
1211:   lv_obj_move_foreground(g_login_qr);
1212:   lv_obj_invalidate(g_login_qr);
1213:   lv_obj_update_layout(g_login_qr);
1214:   lv_obj_get_coords(g_login_qr, &area);
1215:   syslog(LOG_INFO,
1216:          "[HOME][UI] qr ready RGB565 240x240 bytes=%u dark=%u "
1217:          "area=%d,%d-%d,%d hidden=%u revision=%u\n",
1218:          (unsigned int)size, dark_pixels,
1219:          (int)area.x1, (int)area.y1, (int)area.x2, (int)area.y2,
1220:          lv_obj_has_flag(g_login_qr, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN) ? 1 : 0,
1221:          (unsigned int)snapshot->qr_revision);
1222:   return true;
1223: }

31: static unsigned int select_device_cards(unsigned int selected[3])
32: {
33:   bool used[HOME_PANEL_MAX_DEVICES] = {false};
34:   unsigned int count = 0;
35: 
36:   while (count < 3)
37:     {
38:       int best_score = -1;
39:       unsigned int best = 0;
40:       unsigned int index;
41: 
42:       for (index = 0; index < g_ui.family_model->device_count; index++)
43:         {

51:           if (score > best_score)

56:         }
57: 
58:       if (best_score < 0)
59:         {
60:           break;
61:         }
62:       used[best] = true;
63:       selected[count++] = best;
64:     }
65: 
66:   return count;

182:   struct home_ui_control_binding_s *binding;

192:     }
193: 
194:   binding = &g_ui.control_bindings[g_ui.control_binding_count++];
195:   binding->device = device;
196:   binding->property = property;
197: 
198:   /* Control row container */
199: 
200:   row = lv_obj_create(parent);
201:   lv_obj_set_pos(row, 0, y);
202:   lv_obj_set_size(row, 586,
203:                   property->type == HOME_PANEL_CONTROL_NUMBER ? 100 : 68);

205:   lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(row, lv_color_hex(COLOR_SURFACE), 0);

208:   lv_obj_set_style_border_width(row, 1, 0);
209:   lv_obj_set_style_border_color(row, lv_color_hex(COLOR_BORDER), 0);

211:   lv_obj_set_style_pad_all(row, 16, 0);

214:   /* Control name */

216:   label = home_ui_make_label(row, home_ui_control_display_name(property->name), 0, 0,

218:   lv_obj_set_width(label, 360);
219:   lv_label_set_long_mode(label, LV_LABEL_LONG_DOT);
220: 
221:   if (property->type == HOME_PANEL_CONTROL_BOOLEAN)
222:     {
223:       /* Boolean: status text + toggle */
224: 
225:       value_label = home_ui_make_label(row,
226:                                property->has_value ?
227:                                  (property->boolean_value ? "已开启" :
228:                                                             "已关闭") :
229:                                  "状态未知",
230:                                0, 32, lv_color_hex(COLOR_SECONDARY),
231:                                home_panel_font_get());
232:       control = lv_button_create(row);
233:       home_ui_configure_fast_button(control);
234:       lv_obj_set_size(control, 52, 32);
235:       lv_obj_align(control, LV_ALIGN_TOP_RIGHT, 0, 0);
236:       lv_obj_set_style_radius(control, THEME_RADIUS_CTRL, 0);
237:       lv_obj_set_style_shadow_width(control, 0, 0);
238:       lv_obj_set_style_border_width(control, 0, 0);
239:       lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(control, lv_color_hex(COLOR_SURFACE_2), 0);
240:       lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(control, lv_color_hex(COLOR_GREEN),
241:                                 LV_STATE_CHECKED);
242:       lv_obj_set_ext_click_area(control, 10);
243:       lv_obj_add_flag(control, LV_OBJ_FLAG_CHECKABLE);
244:       if (property->boolean_value)
245:         {
246:           lv_obj_add_state(control, LV_STATE_CHECKED);
247:         }
248:       label = lv_label_create(control);
249:       lv_label_set_text(label, LV_SYMBOL_POWER);
250:       lv_obj_set_style_text_font(label, &lv_font_montserrat_16, 0);
251:       lv_obj_center(label);
252:       lv_obj_add_event_cb(control, g_ui.cb_detail_boolean_changed,
253:                           LV_EVENT_VALUE_CHANGED, binding);
254:     }
255:   else if (property->type == HOME_PANEL_CONTROL_NUMBER)
256:     {
257:       /* Number: value + slider */
258: 
259:       home_ui_format_control_value(property, property->value,
260:                            value, sizeof(value));
261:       value_label = home_ui_make_label(row, property->has_value ? value : "--",
262:                                0, 32, lv_color_hex(COLOR_SENSOR),
263:                                home_panel_font_get());
264:       control = lv_slider_create(row);
265:       lv_obj_set_pos(control, 0, 60);
266:       lv_obj_set_size(control, 554, 16);
267:       lv_slider_set_range(control, property->minimum, property->maximum);
268:       lv_slider_set_value(control, property->value, LV_ANIM_OFF);
269:       lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(control, lv_color_hex(COLOR_SURFACE_2),
270:                                 LV_PART_MAIN);
271:       lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(control, lv_color_hex(COLOR_BLUE),
272:                                 LV_PART_INDICATOR);
273:       lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(control, lv_color_hex(COLOR_TEXT),
274:                                 LV_PART_KNOB);
275:       lv_obj_set_style_radius(control, THEME_RADIUS_CTRL, LV_PART_MAIN);
276:       lv_obj_set_style_radius(control, THEME_RADIUS_CTRL,
277:                               LV_PART_INDICATOR);
278:       lv_obj_set_style_radius(control, THEME_RADIUS_CTRL, LV_PART_KNOB);
279:       lv_obj_add_event_cb(control, g_ui.cb_detail_number_changed,
280:                           LV_EVENT_VALUE_CHANGED, binding);
281:       lv_obj_add_event_cb(control, g_ui.cb_detail_number_released,
282:                           LV_EVENT_RELEASED, binding);
283:     }
284:   else
285:     {
286:       char options[HOME_PANEL_MAX_OPTIONS * 28];
287:       unsigned int index;
288:       unsigned int selected = 0;
289:       size_t used = 0;
290: 
291:       options[0] = '\0';
292:       for (index = 0; index < property->option_count; index++)
293:         {
294:           int written = snprintf(options + used, sizeof(options) - used,
295:                                  "%s%s", index == 0 ? "" : "\n",
296:                                  property->options[index].label);
297:           if (written < 0 || (size_t)written >= sizeof(options) - used)
298:             {
299:               break;
300:             }
301:           used += (size_t)written;
302:           if (property->options[index].value == property->value)
303:             {
304:               selected = index;
305:             }
306:         }
307:       value_label = home_ui_make_label(row,
308:                                property->option_count > 0 ?
309:                                  property->options[selected].label : "--",
310:                                0, 32, lv_color_hex(COLOR_SENSOR),
311:                                home_panel_font_get());
312:       control = lv_dropdown_create(row);
313:       lv_obj_set_size(control, 210, 42);
314:       lv_obj_align(control, LV_ALIGN_TOP_RIGHT, 0, 0);
315:       lv_dropdown_set_options(control, options);
316:       lv_dropdown_set_selected(control, selected);
317:       lv_obj_set_style_text_font(control, home_panel_font_get(), 0);
318:       lv_obj_set_style_radius(control, THEME_RADIUS_CTRL, 0);
319:       lv_obj_add_event_cb(control, g_ui.cb_detail_enum_changed,
320:                           LV_EVENT_VALUE_CHANGED, binding);
321:     }
322: 
323:   if (!device->online)
324:     {
325:       lv_obj_add_state(control, LV_STATE_DISABLED);
326:     }
327:   binding->control = control;
328:   binding->value_label = value_label;
329: }

359: static void show_room_device_detail(unsigned int device_index)
360: {
361:   const struct home_panel_device_s *device;
362:   lv_obj_t *back;
363:   lv_obj_t *label;
364:   unsigned int metric = 0;
365:   unsigned int index;
366:   int y = 76;
367:   char value[32];
368:   char subtitle[96];
369: 
370:   if (device_index >= g_ui.family_model->device_count ||
371:       g_ui.room_device_host == NULL)
372:     {
373:       return;
374:     }
375: 
376:   if (g_ui.room_detail_host != NULL)
377:     {
378:       lv_obj_delete(g_ui.room_detail_host);
379:     }
380:   lv_obj_add_flag(g_ui.room_device_host, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
381:   g_ui.room_detail_host = home_ui_make_room_device_container();
382:   rooms_reset_detail_bindings();
383:   g_ui.selected_device = device_index;
384:   device = &g_ui.family_model->devices[device_index];
385:   theme_create_device_ambient_mask(g_ui.room_detail_host, device->type);
386: 
387:   back = lv_button_create(g_ui.room_detail_host);
388:   home_ui_configure_fast_button(back);
389:   lv_obj_set_pos(back, 0, 0);
390:   lv_obj_set_size(back, 42, 42);
391:   lv_obj_set_ext_click_area(back, 5);
392:   lv_obj_set_style_radius(back, THEME_RADIUS_SM, 0);
393:   lv_obj_set_style_shadow_width(back, 0, 0);
394:   lv_obj_set_style_border_width(back, 1, 0);
395:   lv_obj_set_style_border_color(back, lv_color_hex(COLOR_BORDER), 0);
396:   lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(back, lv_color_hex(COLOR_SURFACE), 0);
397:   lv_obj_add_event_cb(back, close_room_device_detail, LV_EVENT_CLICKED, NULL);
398:   label = lv_label_create(back);
399:   lv_label_set_text(label, LV_SYMBOL_LEFT);
400:   lv_obj_set_style_text_font(label, &lv_font_montserrat_16, 0);
401:   lv_obj_center(label);
402: 
403:   label = home_ui_make_label(g_ui.room_detail_host, device->name, 56, 0,
404:                      lv_color_hex(COLOR_TEXT), home_panel_font_get());
405:   lv_obj_set_width(label, 420);
406:   lv_label_set_long_mode(label, LV_LABEL_LONG_DOT);
407:   snprintf(subtitle, sizeof(subtitle), "%s · %s",
408:            home_ui_device_type_text(device), device->online ? "在线" : "离线");
409:   g_ui.detail_subtitle_label = home_ui_make_label(
410:     g_ui.room_detail_host, subtitle, 56, 32,
411:     lv_color_hex(device->online ? COLOR_SECONDARY : COLOR_MUTED),
412:     home_panel_font_get());
413: 
414:   if (device->has_temperature)
415:     {
416:       snprintf(value, sizeof(value), "%d°C", device->temperature);
417:       g_ui.detail_temperature_label = make_detail_metric(
418:         g_ui.room_detail_host, (int)metric++ * 196, y,
419:         "温度", value, lv_color_hex(COLOR_ORANGE));
420:     }
421:   if (device->has_humidity)
422:     {
423:       snprintf(value, sizeof(value), "%d%%", device->humidity);
424:       g_ui.detail_humidity_label = make_detail_metric(
425:         g_ui.room_detail_host, (int)metric++ * 196, y,
426:         "湿度", value, lv_color_hex(COLOR_BLUE));
427:     }
428:   if (device->has_battery && metric < 3)
429:     {
430:       snprintf(value, sizeof(value), "%d%%", device->battery);
431:       g_ui.detail_battery_label = make_detail_metric(
432:         g_ui.room_detail_host, (int)metric++ * 196, y,
433:         "电量", value, lv_color_hex(COLOR_GREEN));
434:     }
435: 
436:   for (index = 0; index < device->observable_count && metric < 9; index++)
437:     {
438:       const struct home_panel_observable_s *observable =
439:         &device->observables[index];
440:       bool standard =
441:         (observable->siid == device->temperature_siid &&
442:          observable->piid == device->temperature_piid) ||
443:         (observable->siid == device->humidity_siid &&
444:          observable->piid == device->humidity_piid) ||
445:         (observable->siid == device->battery_siid &&
446:          observable->piid == device->battery_piid) ||
447:         (observable->siid == device->power_siid &&
448:          observable->piid == device->power_piid);
449: 
450:       if (standard || !observable->has_value)
451:         {
452:           continue;
453:         }
454:       if (metric > 0 && metric % 3 == 0)
455:         {
456:           y += 90;
457:         }
458:       if (observable->text[0] != '\0')
459:         {
460:           snprintf(value, sizeof(value), "%s", observable->text);
461:         }
462:       else if (observable->type == HOME_PANEL_CONTROL_BOOLEAN)
463:         {
464:           snprintf(value, sizeof(value), "%s",
465:                    observable->boolean_value ? "是" : "否");
466:         }
467:       else
468:         {
469:           snprintf(value, sizeof(value), "%d", observable->value);
470:         }
471:       make_detail_metric(g_ui.room_detail_host, (int)(metric % 3) * 196, y,
472:                          home_ui_control_display_name(observable->name), value,
473:                          lv_color_hex(COLOR_SENSOR));
474:       metric++;
475:     }
476: 
477:   if (metric > 0)
478:     {
479:       y += 90;
480:     }
481: 
482:   for (index = 0; index < device->control_count; index++)
483:     {
484:       make_detail_control(g_ui.room_detail_host, y, device,
485:                           &device->controls[index]);
486:       y += device->controls[index].type == HOME_PANEL_CONTROL_NUMBER ?
487:            104 : 76;
488:     }
489: 
490:   for (index = 0; index < device->action_count &&
491:                   g_ui.action_binding_count < HOME_PANEL_MAX_ACTIONS; index++)
492:     {
493:       struct home_ui_action_binding_s *binding =
494:         &g_ui.action_bindings[g_ui.action_binding_count++];
495:       lv_obj_t *button;
496: 
497:       binding->device = device;
498:       binding->action = &device->actions[index];
499:       button = home_ui_make_action_button(g_ui.room_detail_host,
500:                                   device->actions[index].display_name,
501:                                   0, y, 240);
502:       lv_obj_remove_event_cb(button, home_ui_action_clicked);
503:       lv_obj_add_event_cb(button, g_ui.cb_detail_action_clicked,
504:                           LV_EVENT_CLICKED, binding);
505:       if (!device->online)
506:         {
507:           lv_obj_add_state(button, LV_STATE_DISABLED);
508:         }
509:       y += 54;
510:     }
511: 
512:   if (metric == 0 && device->control_count == 0 &&
513:       device->action_count == 0)
514:     {
515:       label = home_ui_make_label(g_ui.room_detail_host, "该设备暂无可用控制项", 0, y,
516:                          lv_color_hex(COLOR_MUTED), home_panel_font_get());
517:       lv_obj_set_width(label, 586);
518:       lv_obj_set_style_text_align(label, LV_TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER, 0);
519:     }
520: 
521:   home_ui_set_label_text_if_changed(g_ui.room_title_label, device->name);
522:   home_ui_set_label_text_if_changed(g_ui.room_summary_label, subtitle);
523:   g_ui.status_label = g_ui.room_summary_label;
524:   syslog(LOG_INFO, "[HOME][UI] device=%s type=%s controls=%u\n",
525:          device->name, device->type, device->control_count);
526: }

514: {

523:     }

528: static void replay_clicked(lv_event_t *event)
529: {
530:   (void)event;
531:   proactive_ctrl_start_replay(lv_tick_get());
532:   home_ui_set_label_text_if_changed(g_ui.proactive_feedback_label,
533:                                     "演示数据不会写入真实用户画像");
534:   proactive_ctrl_get_viewmodel(&g_vm);
535:   apply_viewmodel_to_widgets();
536: }

538: static void reset_clicked(lv_event_t *event)
539: {
540:   (void)event;
541:   if (g_vm.proactive.mode != HOME_PROACTIVE_REAL)
542:     {
543:       home_ui_set_label_text_if_changed(g_ui.proactive_feedback_label,
544:                                         "请先返回真实模式再重置画像");
545:       return;
546:     }
547:   proactive_ctrl_reset();
548:   proactive_ctrl_update_context();
549:   proactive_ctrl_schedule_persist();
550:   home_ui_set_label_text_if_changed(g_ui.proactive_feedback_label,
551:                                     "真实用户画像已重置");
552:   proactive_ctrl_get_viewmodel(&g_vm);
553:   apply_viewmodel_to_widgets();
554: }

557: {
558:   (void)event;
559:   proactive_ctrl_stop_replay();
560:   proactive_ctrl_update_context();
561:   home_ui_set_label_text_if_changed(g_ui.proactive_feedback_label,
562:                                     "已恢复回放前的真实画像");
563:   proactive_ctrl_get_viewmodel(&g_vm);
564:   apply_viewmodel_to_widgets();
565: }

567: static void automation_delete_clicked(lv_event_t *event)
568: {
569:   struct home_ui_proactive_automation_ui_s *binding =
570:     lv_event_get_user_data(event);
571:   int ret;
572: 
573:   if (binding == NULL || binding->routine_id == 0)
574:     {
575:       return;
576:     }

578:   ret = proactive_ctrl_delete_automation(binding->routine_id, binding->cloud);
579:   if (ret == 0)
580:     {
581:       home_ui_set_label_text_if_changed(g_ui.proactive_feedback_label,
582:                                         "离线自动化已删除并停止执行");
583:       g_ui.proactive_automation_signature = 0;
584:       proactive_ctrl_get_viewmodel(&g_vm);
585:       apply_viewmodel_to_widgets();
586:     }
587:   else
588:     {
589:       home_ui_set_label_text_if_changed(g_ui.proactive_feedback_label,
590:                                         "自动化已不存在，无需重复删除");
591:     }
592: }

594: static void confirm_close(lv_event_t *event)
595: {
596:   lv_obj_t *shade = lv_event_get_user_data(event);
597: 
598:   if (shade != NULL && shade == g_ui.proactive_confirm_shade)
599:     {
600:       g_ui.proactive_confirm_shade = NULL;
601:       g_ui.proactive_confirm_key = 0;
602:       lv_obj_delete(shade);
603:     }
604: }
605: 
606: static void confirm_accept(lv_event_t *event)
607: {
608:   lv_obj_t *shade = lv_event_get_user_data(event);
609:   uint32_t expected_key = g_ui.proactive_confirm_key;
610: 
611:   if (shade == NULL || shade != g_ui.proactive_confirm_shade)
612:     {
613:       return;
614:     }
615: 
616:   g_ui.proactive_confirm_shade = NULL;
617:   g_ui.proactive_confirm_key = 0;
618:   lv_obj_delete(shade);
619: 
620:   /* Refresh view-model and check if suggestion is still valid */
621: 
622:   proactive_ctrl_get_viewmodel(&g_vm);
623:   if (!g_vm.proactive.suggestion_available ||
624:       g_vm.proactive.decision_key != expected_key)
625:     {
626:       home_ui_set_label_text_if_changed(g_ui.proactive_feedback_label,
627:                                         "建议已发生变化，请重新确认");
628:       apply_viewmodel_to_widgets();
629:       return;
630:     }
631: 
632:   proactive_ctrl_handle_feedback(HOME_PROACTIVE_ENABLE_AUTOMATION, true,
633:                                  &g_vm);
634:   if (g_vm.feedback_message[0] != '\0')
635:     {
636:       home_ui_set_label_text_if_changed(g_ui.proactive_feedback_label,
637:                                         g_vm.feedback_message);
638:     }
639:   apply_viewmodel_to_widgets();
640:   home_page_update_suggestion();
641: }

1884: static bool device_structure_changed(
1885:   const struct home_panel_device_s *before,
1886:   const struct home_panel_device_s *after)
1887: {
1888:   unsigned int index;
1889: 
1890:   if (strcmp(before->did, after->did) != 0 ||
1891:       strcmp(before->name, after->name) != 0 ||
1892:       strcmp(before->room, after->room) != 0 ||
1893:       strcmp(before->model, after->model) != 0 ||
1894:       strcmp(before->type, after->type) != 0 ||
1895:       before->has_power != after->has_power ||
1896:       before->power_writable != after->power_writable ||
1897:       before->power_siid != after->power_siid ||
1898:       before->power_piid != after->power_piid ||
1899:       before->has_brightness != after->has_brightness ||
1900:       before->has_temperature != after->has_temperature ||
1901:       before->has_humidity != after->has_humidity ||
1902:       before->has_battery != after->has_battery ||
1903:       before->control_count != after->control_count)
1904:     {
1905:       return true;
1906:     }
1907: 
1908:   for (index = 0; index < after->control_count; index++)
1909:     {
1910:       const struct home_panel_control_s *left = &before->controls[index];
1911:       const struct home_panel_control_s *right = &after->controls[index];
1912: 
1913:       if (strcmp(left->name, right->name) != 0 ||
1914:           left->siid != right->siid || left->piid != right->piid ||
1915:           left->type != right->type ||
1916:           left->has_range != right->has_range ||
1917:           left->minimum != right->minimum ||
1918:           left->maximum != right->maximum || left->step != right->step)
1919:         {
1920:           return true;
1921:         }
1922:     }
1923: 
1924:   return false;
1925: }

1972: static void update_device_binding(
1973:   struct home_panel_device_binding_s *binding)
1974: {
1975:   const struct home_panel_device_s *device = binding->device;
1976:   bool checked;
1977:   bool current_checked;
1978:   bool disabled;
1979:   bool state_text_changed;
1980:   char value[32];
1981: 
1982:   if (device == NULL || binding->value_label == NULL ||
1983:       binding->state_label == NULL)
1984:     {
1985:       return;
1986:     }
1987: 
1988:   checked = device->has_power && device->power;
1989:   format_device_value(device, value, sizeof(value));
1990:   set_label_text_if_changed(binding->value_label, value);
1991:   state_text_changed = set_label_text_if_changed(
1992:     binding->state_label, device_state_text(device));
1993: 
1994:   if (binding->card != NULL)
1995:     {
1996:       theme_apply_card_state(
1997:         binding->card,
1998:         !device->online ? HOME_PANEL_CARD_OFFLINE :
1999:         checked ? HOME_PANEL_CARD_ACTIVE : HOME_PANEL_CARD_IDLE);
2000:     }
2001: 
2002:   if (binding->button == NULL)
2003:     {
2004:       if (state_text_changed)
2005:         {
2006:           lv_obj_set_style_text_color(
2007:             binding->state_label,
2008:             lv_color_hex(device->online ? COLOR_SECONDARY : COLOR_MUTED),
2009:             0);
2010:         }
2011:       return;
2012:     }
2013: 
2014:   current_checked = lv_obj_has_state(binding->button, LV_STATE_CHECKED);
2015:   if (state_text_changed || checked != current_checked)
2016:     {
2017:       lv_obj_set_style_text_color(
2018:         binding->state_label,
2019:         lv_color_hex(checked ? COLOR_GREEN : COLOR_MUTED), 0);
2020:     }
2021: 
2022:   if (checked != current_checked)
2023:     {
2024:       style_toggle(binding->button, checked);
2025:       if (checked)
2026:         {
2027:           lv_obj_add_state(binding->button, LV_STATE_CHECKED);
2028:         }
2029:       else
2030:         {
2031:           lv_obj_remove_state(binding->button, LV_STATE_CHECKED);
2032:         }
2033:     }
2034: 
2035:   disabled = lv_obj_has_state(binding->button, LV_STATE_DISABLED);
2036:   if (device->online && disabled)
2037:     {
2038:       lv_obj_remove_state(binding->button, LV_STATE_DISABLED);
2039:     }
2040:   else if (!device->online && !disabled)
2041:     {
2042:       lv_obj_add_state(binding->button, LV_STATE_DISABLED);
2043:     }
2044: }

2046: static void update_control_binding(
2047:   struct home_panel_control_binding_s *binding)
2048: {
2049:   const struct home_panel_control_s *property = binding->property;
2050:   bool disabled;
2051:   char value[24];
2052: 
2053:   if (binding->device == NULL || property == NULL ||
2054:       binding->control == NULL || binding->value_label == NULL)
2055:     {
2056:       return;
2057:     }
2058: 
2059:   if (property->type == HOME_PANEL_CONTROL_BOOLEAN)
2060:     {
2061:       bool checked = lv_obj_has_state(binding->control, LV_STATE_CHECKED);
2062: 
2063:       set_label_text_if_changed(binding->value_label,
2064:                                 property->has_value ?
2065:                                   (property->boolean_value ? "已开启" :
2066:                                                              "已关闭") :
2067:                                   "状态未知");
2068:       if (checked != property->boolean_value)
2069:         {
2070:           style_toggle(binding->control, property->boolean_value);
2071:           if (property->boolean_value)
2072:             {
2073:               lv_obj_add_state(binding->control, LV_STATE_CHECKED);
2074:             }
2075:           else
2076:             {
2077:               lv_obj_remove_state(binding->control, LV_STATE_CHECKED);
2078:             }
2079:         }
2080:     }
2081:   else if (property->type == HOME_PANEL_CONTROL_NUMBER)
2082:     {
2083:       if (!lv_obj_has_state(binding->control, LV_STATE_PRESSED))
2084:         {
2085:           lv_slider_set_value(binding->control, property->value,
2086:                               LV_ANIM_OFF);
2087:           format_control_value(property, property->value,
2088:                                value, sizeof(value));
2089:           set_label_text_if_changed(binding->value_label,
2090:                                     property->has_value ? value : "--");
2091:         }
2092:     }
2093:   else
2094:     {
2095:       unsigned int index;
2096:       unsigned int selected = 0;
2097: 
2098:       for (index = 0; index < property->option_count; index++)
2099:         {
2100:           if (property->options[index].value == property->value)
2101:             {
2102:               selected = index;
2103:               break;
2104:             }
2105:         }
2106:       if (!lv_obj_has_state(binding->control, LV_STATE_PRESSED))
2107:         {
2108:           lv_dropdown_set_selected(binding->control, selected);
2109:           set_label_text_if_changed(
2110:             binding->value_label,
2111:             property->option_count > 0 ?
2112:               property->options[selected].label : "--");
2113:         }
2114:     }
2115: 
2116:   disabled = lv_obj_has_state(binding->control, LV_STATE_DISABLED);
2117:   if (binding->device->online && disabled)
2118:     {
2119:       lv_obj_remove_state(binding->control, LV_STATE_DISABLED);
2120:     }
2121:   else if (!binding->device->online && !disabled)
2122:     {
2123:       lv_obj_add_state(binding->control, LV_STATE_DISABLED);
2124:     }
2125: }

2273: static int refresh_family_model(
2274:   const struct home_panel_mijia_family_snapshot_s *snapshot,
2275:   const struct home_panel_family_model_s *model)
2276: {
2277:   bool changed;
2278:   bool structure_changed;
2279: 
2280:   if (snapshot == NULL || model == NULL || snapshot->revision == 0 ||
2281:       snapshot->json_size == 0 || model->revision != snapshot->revision)
2282:     {
2283:       return -EAGAIN;
2284:     }
2285: 
2286:   /* The client only hands out a new model when its revision changed, so a
2287:    * full 118 KiB memcmp here would always be true.  Compare the revision
2288:    * field instead and skip the expensive scan.
2289:    */
2290: 
2291:   changed = !g_family_model_valid ||
2292:             model->revision != g_family_model.revision;
2293:   if (changed)
2294:     {
2295:       structure_changed = !g_family_model_valid ||
2296:         family_structure_changed(&g_family_model, model);
2297:       if (g_family_model_valid)
2298:         {
2299:           proactive_ctrl_observe_model_changes(&g_family_model, model);
2300:         }
2301:       memcpy(&g_family_model, model, sizeof(g_family_model));
2302:       g_family_model_valid = true;
2303:       if (structure_changed)
2304:         {
2305:           g_family_ui_revision++;
2306:           if (g_family_ui_revision == 0)
2307:             {
2308:               g_family_ui_revision = 1;
2309:             }
2310:         }
2311:       else
2312:         {
2313:           update_model_widgets();
2314:         }
2315:       syslog(LOG_INFO,
2316:              "[HOME][MODEL] revision=%u devices=%u online=%u rooms=%u "
2317:              "scenes=%u event=%s mqtt=%u update=%s\n",
2318:              (unsigned int)model->revision, model->device_count,
2319:              model->online_count, model->room_count, model->scene_count,
2320:              model->event_source, model->mqtt_connected ? 1 : 0,
2321:              structure_changed ? "rebuild" : "in-place");
2322:       return structure_changed ? 0 : 2;
2323:     }
2324: 
2325:   g_family_model.revision = model->revision;
2326:   syslog(LOG_INFO,
2327:          "[HOME][MODEL] revision=%u display-unchanged\n",
2328:          (unsigned int)model->revision);
2329:   return 1;
2330: }

2336: static void cb_device_toggled(lv_event_t *event)
2337: {
2338:   lv_obj_t *button = lv_event_get_target(event);
2339:   struct home_ui_device_binding_s *binding =
2340:     lv_event_get_user_data(event);
2341:   bool requested;
2342:   int ret;
2343: 
2344:   if (binding == NULL || binding->device == NULL ||
2345:       !binding->device->power_writable || !binding->device->online)
2346:     {
2347:       return;
2348:     }
2349: 
2350:   requested = lv_obj_has_state(button, LV_STATE_CHECKED);
2351:   ret = home_panel_mijia_request_bool_property(binding->device->did,
2352:                                                 binding->device->name,
2353:                                                 "on",
2354:                                                 binding->device->power_siid,
2355:                                                 binding->device->power_piid,
2356:                                                 requested);
2357: 
2358:   if (ret == 0)
2359:     {
2360:       /* Optimistic update: keep the user's intended state while the cloud
2361:        * confirm is in flight.  Rolling back to the stale model value makes
2362:        * the switch bounce and fights the user's gesture.
2363:        */
2364: 
2365:       lv_obj_add_state(button, LV_STATE_DISABLED);
2366:       lv_label_set_text(binding->state_label,
2367:                         requested ? "正在开启" : "正在关闭");
2368:       lv_obj_set_style_text_color(binding->state_label,
2369:                                   lv_color_hex(COLOR_BLUE), 0);
2370:       set_command_status(ret);
2371:     }
2372:   else
2373:     {
2374:       /* Revert to the authoritative model value only on failure. */
2375: 
2376:       if (binding->device->power)
2377:         {
2378:           lv_obj_add_state(button, LV_STATE_CHECKED);
2379:         }
2380:       else
2381:         {
2382:           lv_obj_remove_state(button, LV_STATE_CHECKED);
2383:         }
2384: 
2385:       set_command_status(ret);
2386:     }
2387: }

2704: static void log_fpu_state(void)
2705: {
2706: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_FPU
2707:   uint32_t mstatus;
2708:   uint32_t mexstatus;
2709:   uint32_t fcsr;
2710: 
2711:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrr %0, mstatus" : "=r"(mstatus));
2712:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrr %0, 0x7e1" : "=r"(mexstatus));
2713:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrr %0, fcsr" : "=r"(fcsr));
2714:   syslog(LOG_INFO,
2715:          "[HOME][FPU] mstatus=%08lx fs=%lu fcsr=%08lx mexstatus=%08lx "
2716:          "spush=%lu spswap=%lu\n",
2717:          (unsigned long)mstatus, (unsigned long)((mstatus >> 13) & 3u),
2718:          (unsigned long)fcsr, (unsigned long)mexstatus,
2719:          (unsigned long)((mexstatus >> 16) & 1u),
2720:          (unsigned long)((mexstatus >> 17) & 1u));
2721: #endif
2722: }

19: #define HOME_FONT_FILE_NAME     "MiSans-Regular-18-full.bin"
20: #define HOME_FONT_CACHE_BYTES   (16 * 1024)
21: 
22: struct home_font_file_s
23: {
24:   uint32_t position;

31: static bool home_font_metrics_valid(const lv_font_t *font)
32: {
33:   static const uint32_t samples[] =
34:   {
35:     0x5bb6, /* 家 */
36:     0x5ead, /* 庭 */
37:     0x623f, /* 房 */
38:     0x95f4, /* 间 */
39:     0x8bbe, /* 设 */
40:     0x7f6e, /* 置 */
41:   };
42:   lv_font_glyph_dsc_t glyph;
43:   unsigned int index;
44: 
45:   if (font == NULL || font->line_height < 16 || font->line_height > 40 ||
46:       font->base_line < 0 || font->base_line >= font->line_height)
47:     {
48:       return false;
49:     }
50: 
51:   for (index = 0; index < sizeof(samples) / sizeof(samples[0]); index++)
52:     {
53:       memset(&glyph, 0, sizeof(glyph));
54:       if (!lv_font_get_glyph_dsc(font, &glyph, samples[index], 0) ||
55:           glyph.adv_w < 8 || glyph.adv_w > 32 ||
56:           glyph.box_w == 0 || glyph.box_h == 0)
57:         {
58:           return false;
59:         }
60:     }
61: 
62:   return true;
63: }

65: static void *home_font_open(lv_fs_drv_t *drv, const char *path,
66:                             lv_fs_mode_t mode)
67: {
68:   struct home_font_file_s *file;
69: 
70:   (void)drv;
71:   if (mode != LV_FS_MODE_RD || strcmp(path, HOME_FONT_FILE_NAME) != 0)
72:     {
73:       return NULL;
74:     }
75: 
76:   file = malloc(sizeof(*file));
77:   if (file != NULL)
78:     {
79:       file->position = 0;
80:     }
81: 
82:   return file;
83: }

85: static lv_fs_res_t home_font_close(lv_fs_drv_t *drv, void *file_p)
86: {

88:   free(file_p);

90: }

92: static lv_fs_res_t home_font_read(lv_fs_drv_t *drv, void *file_p,
93:                                   void *buffer, uint32_t bytes_to_read,
94:                                   uint32_t *bytes_read)
95: {
96:   struct home_font_file_s *file = file_p;
97:   uint32_t remaining;
98:   int ret;
99: 
100:   (void)drv;
101:   if (file == NULL || buffer == NULL || bytes_read == NULL)
102:     {
103:       return LV_FS_RES_INV_PARAM;
104:     }
105: 
106:   remaining = BOARD_FONT_FLASH_SIZE - file->position;
107:   if (bytes_to_read > remaining)
108:     {
109:       bytes_to_read = remaining;
110:     }
111: 
112:   if (bytes_to_read == 0)
113:     {
114:       *bytes_read = 0;
115:       return LV_FS_RES_OK;
116:     }
117: 
118:   ret = board_flash_read(BOARD_FONT_FLASH_OFFSET + file->position, buffer,
119:                          bytes_to_read);
120:   if (ret < 0)
121:     {
122:       *bytes_read = 0;
123:       return LV_FS_RES_HW_ERR;
124:     }
125: 
126:   file->position += bytes_to_read;
127:   *bytes_read = bytes_to_read;
128:   return LV_FS_RES_OK;
129: }
130: 
131: static lv_fs_res_t home_font_seek(lv_fs_drv_t *drv, void *file_p,
132:                                   uint32_t position,
133:                                   lv_fs_whence_t whence)
134: {
135:   struct home_font_file_s *file = file_p;
136:   uint32_t target;
137: 
138:   (void)drv;
139:   if (file == NULL)
140:     {
141:       return LV_FS_RES_INV_PARAM;
142:     }
143: 
144:   switch (whence)
145:     {
146:       case LV_FS_SEEK_SET:
147:         target = position;
148:         break;
149:       case LV_FS_SEEK_CUR:
150:         if (position > BOARD_FONT_FLASH_SIZE - file->position)
151:           {
152:             return LV_FS_RES_INV_PARAM;
153:           }
154: 
155:         target = file->position + position;
156:         break;
157:       case LV_FS_SEEK_END:
158:         if (position > BOARD_FONT_FLASH_SIZE)
159:           {
160:             return LV_FS_RES_INV_PARAM;
161:           }
162: 
163:         target = BOARD_FONT_FLASH_SIZE - position;
164:         break;
165:       default:
166:         return LV_FS_RES_INV_PARAM;
167:     }
168: 
169:   if (target > BOARD_FONT_FLASH_SIZE)
170:     {
171:       return LV_FS_RES_INV_PARAM;
172:     }
173: 
174:   file->position = target;
175:   return LV_FS_RES_OK;
176: }
177: 
178: static lv_fs_res_t home_font_tell(lv_fs_drv_t *drv, void *file_p,
179:                                   uint32_t *position)
180: {
181:   struct home_font_file_s *file = file_p;
182: 
183:   (void)drv;
184:   if (file == NULL || position == NULL)
185:     {
186:       return LV_FS_RES_INV_PARAM;
187:     }
188: 
189:   *position = file->position;
190:   return LV_FS_RES_OK;
191: }

193: int home_panel_font_initialize(void)
194: {
195:   uint8_t signature[4] = {0};
196:   int ret;
197: 
198:   ret = board_flash_read(BOARD_FONT_FLASH_OFFSET, signature,
199:                          sizeof(signature));
200:   if (ret < 0 || signature[0] != 0x30 || signature[1] != 0x00 ||
201:       signature[2] != 0x00 || signature[3] != 0x00)
202:     {
203:       syslog(LOG_ERR,
204:              "[HOME][FONT] invalid flash font ret=%d sig=%02x%02x%02x%02x\n",
205:              ret, signature[0], signature[1], signature[2], signature[3]);
206:       return ret < 0 ? ret : -EBADMSG;
207:     }
208: 
209:   lv_fs_drv_init(&g_font_fs);
210:   g_font_fs.letter = HOME_FONT_DRIVE_LETTER;
211:   g_font_fs.cache_size = HOME_FONT_CACHE_BYTES;
212:   g_font_fs.open_cb = home_font_open;
213:   g_font_fs.close_cb = home_font_close;
214:   g_font_fs.read_cb = home_font_read;
215:   g_font_fs.seek_cb = home_font_seek;
216:   g_font_fs.tell_cb = home_font_tell;
217:   lv_fs_drv_register(&g_font_fs);
218: 
219:   g_runtime_font = lv_binfont_create(HOME_FONT_PATH);
220:   if (g_runtime_font == NULL)
221:     {
222:       syslog(LOG_ERR, "[HOME][FONT] binary font initialization failed\n");
223:       return -EINVAL;
224:     }
225: 
226:   if (!home_font_metrics_valid(g_runtime_font))
227:     {

229:              "[HOME][FONT] binary font metrics rejected line=%ld base=%ld\n",
230:              (long)g_runtime_font->line_height,
231:              (long)g_runtime_font->base_line);
232:       lv_binfont_destroy(g_runtime_font);
233:       g_runtime_font = NULL;
234:       return -EBADMSG;
235:     }
236: 
237:   g_runtime_font->fallback = &home_panel_misans_18;
238:   g_home_font = g_runtime_font;
239:   syslog(LOG_INFO,
240:          "[HOME][FONT] full MiSans bitmap ready bytes=%u bpp=1 "
241:          "line=%ld base=%ld\n",
242:          (unsigned int)BOARD_FONT_FLASH_SIZE,
243:          (long)g_runtime_font->line_height,
244:          (long)g_runtime_font->base_line);
245:   return 0;
246: }

374: /* Device card */
375: 
376: static const char *device_state_text(const struct home_panel_device_s *device)
377: {
378:   if (!device->online)
379:     {
380:       return "离线";
381:     }
382:   if (device->has_power)
383:     {
384:       return device->power ? "已开启" : "已关闭";
385:     }
386:   return "状态已同步";
387: }
388: 
389: static const char *device_symbol(const struct home_panel_device_s *device)
390: {
391:   if (strcmp(device->type, "light") == 0)
392:     {
393:       return LV_SYMBOL_BULLET;
394:     }
395:   if (strcmp(device->type, "outlet") == 0)
396:     {
397:       return LV_SYMBOL_CHARGE;
398:     }
399:   return LV_SYMBOL_POWER;
400: }
401: 
402: static void format_device_value(const struct home_panel_device_s *device,
403:                                 char *value, size_t capacity)
404: {
405:   if (device->has_brightness)
406:     {
407:       int span = device->brightness_max - device->brightness_min;
408:       int percent = span > 0 ?
409:         (device->brightness - device->brightness_min) * 100 / span : 0;
410:       snprintf(value, capacity, "%d%%", percent);
411:     }
412:   else if (device->has_temperature)
413:     {
414:       snprintf(value, capacity, "%d°C", device->temperature);
415:     }
416:   else if (device->has_humidity)
417:     {
418:       snprintf(value, capacity, "湿度 %d%%", device->humidity);
419:     }
420:   else if (device->has_battery)
421:     {
422:       snprintf(value, capacity, "%d%%", device->battery);
423:     }
424:   else
425:     {
426:       snprintf(value, capacity, "%s", device->online ? "在线" : "离线");
427:     }
428: }

459: {
460:   struct mijia_credentials_s credentials;
461:   size_t length = 0;
462:   int ret;
463: 
464:   memset(&credentials, 0, sizeof(credentials));

466:   if (ret < 0)

474:       credentials.endpoint_hash != mijia_endpoint_hash() ||

561: static int mijia_download_login_qr(const char *session_id,
562:                                    uint32_t generation)
563: {
564:   static const char *headers[] =
565:   {
566:     "Accept: application/octet-stream",
567:     "Connection: close"
568:   };
569:   struct webclient_context context;
570:   struct mijia_response_s sink;
571:   char path[96];
572:   char url[512];
573:   char http_buffer[MIJIA_HTTP_BUFFER_SIZE];
574:   uint8_t *wire_data;
575:   int length;
576:   int ret;
577: 
578:   wire_data = malloc(MIJIA_QR_WIRE_SIZE);
579:   if (wire_data == NULL)
580:     {
581:       return -ENOMEM;
582:     }
583: 
584:   length = snprintf(path, sizeof(path),
585:                     "/api/login/qr.rgb565?session_id=%s", session_id);
586:   if (length < 0 || (size_t)length >= sizeof(path))
587:     {
588:       free(wire_data);
589:       return -ENAMETOOLONG;
590:     }
591: 
592:   length = snprintf(url, sizeof(url), "%s%s",
593:                     CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_SERVER_URL, path);
594:   if (length < 0 || (size_t)length >= sizeof(url))
595:     {
596:       free(wire_data);
597:       return -ENAMETOOLONG;
598:     }
599: 
600:   memset(&sink, 0, sizeof(sink));
601:   sink.data = (char *)wire_data;
602:   sink.capacity = MIJIA_QR_WIRE_SIZE;
603:   webclient_set_defaults(&context);
604:   context.method = "GET";
605:   context.url = url;
606:   context.buffer = http_buffer;
607:   context.buflen = sizeof(http_buffer);
608:   context.headers = headers;
609:   context.nheaders = sizeof(headers) / sizeof(headers[0]);
610:   context.sink_callback = mijia_binary_sink;
611:   context.sink_callback_arg = &sink;
612:   context.timeout_sec = CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_TIMEOUT;
613:   ret = webclient_perform(&context);
614:   if (ret >= 0 && (context.http_status < 200 || context.http_status >= 300))
615:     {
616:       ret = -EPROTO;
617:     }
618: 
619:   if (ret >= 0 &&
620:       (sink.length != MIJIA_QR_WIRE_SIZE ||
621:        memcmp(wire_data, "HQR2", 4) != 0 ||
622:        wire_data[4] != 0 || wire_data[5] != MIJIA_QR_WIDTH ||
623:        wire_data[6] != 0 || wire_data[7] != MIJIA_QR_HEIGHT ||
624:        wire_data[8] != (MIJIA_QR_STRIDE >> 8) ||
625:        wire_data[9] != (MIJIA_QR_STRIDE & 0xff) ||
626:        wire_data[10] != 2 || wire_data[11] != 0))
627:     {
628:       ret = -EBADMSG;
629:     }
630: 
631:   if (ret >= 0)
632:     {
633:       pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mijia.lock);
634:       if (generation != g_mijia.request_generation)
635:         {
636:           ret = -ECANCELED;
637:         }
638:       else
639:         {
640:           memcpy(g_mijia_qr_data,
641:                  wire_data + MIJIA_QR_WIRE_HEADER_SIZE,
642:                  MIJIA_QR_DATA_SIZE);
643:           g_mijia.qr_size = MIJIA_QR_DATA_SIZE;
644:           g_mijia.snapshot.qr_size = MIJIA_QR_DATA_SIZE;
645:           g_mijia.snapshot.qr_revision = ++g_mijia.next_qr_revision;
646:           syslog(LOG_INFO,
647:                  "[HOME][MIJIA] qr downloaded format=RGB565 %ux%u bytes=%u\n",
648:                  MIJIA_QR_WIDTH, MIJIA_QR_HEIGHT,
649:                  (unsigned int)MIJIA_QR_DATA_SIZE);
650:         }
651:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
652:     }
653:   else
654:     {
655:       syslog(LOG_WARNING,
656:              "[HOME][MIJIA] qr download failed ret=%d status=%u bytes=%u\n",
657:              ret, context.http_status, (unsigned int)sink.length);
658:     }
659: 
660:   free(wire_data);
661:   return ret;
662: }

990: static int mijia_fetch_family(const char *token, uint32_t generation,
991:                               char *home_name, size_t home_capacity,
992:                               unsigned int *device_count,
993:                               unsigned int *online_count)
994: {
995:   char authorization[192];
996:   const char *headers[2];
997:   struct webclient_context context;
998:   struct mijia_response_s sink;
999:   cJSON *devices;
1000:   cJSON *homes;
1001:   cJSON *scenes;
1002:   cJSON *summary;
1003:   cJSON *root = NULL;
1004:   char *response;
1005:   char url[512];
1006:   char buffer[MIJIA_HTTP_BUFFER_SIZE];
1007:   const char *primary_home;
1008:   unsigned int detail_error_count;
1009:   unsigned int generated_at;
1010:   unsigned int home_count;
1011:   unsigned int room_count;
1012:   unsigned int scene_count;
1013:   unsigned int server_revision;
1014:   struct home_panel_family_model_s *parsed_model = NULL;
1015:   int ret = -ENOMEM;
1016: 
1017:   /* The model is ~118 KiB.  Both full sync and delta merge run inside the
1018:    * single mijia_worker thread, so a reused scratch buffer avoids a repeated
1019:    * large malloc/free cycle on every long poll change and keeps the heap
1020:    * free of fragmentation.
1021:    */
1022: 
1023:   static struct home_panel_family_model_s g_sync_model;
1024: 
1025:   response = malloc(CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_MAX_RESPONSE);
1026:   if (response == NULL)
1027:     {
1028:       return -ENOMEM;
1029:     }
1030: 
1031:   memset(&context, 0, sizeof(context));
1032:   memset(&sink, 0, sizeof(sink));
1033: 
1034:   snprintf(url, sizeof(url), "%s/api/sync",
1035:            CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_SERVER_URL);
1036:   snprintf(authorization, sizeof(authorization),
1037:            "Authorization: Bearer %s", token);
1038:   headers[0] = authorization;
1039:   headers[1] = "Connection: close";
1040:   sink.data = response;
1041:   sink.capacity = CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_MAX_RESPONSE;
1042:   response[0] = '\0';
1043: 
1044:   webclient_set_defaults(&context);
1045:   context.method = "GET";
1046:   context.url = url;
1047:   context.buffer = buffer;
1048:   context.buflen = sizeof(buffer);
1049:   context.headers = headers;
1050:   context.nheaders = 2;
1051:   context.sink_callback = mijia_response_sink;
1052:   context.sink_callback_arg = &sink;
1053:   context.timeout_sec = CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_TIMEOUT;
1054:   ret = webclient_perform(&context);
1055:   if (ret < 0 || context.http_status < 200 || context.http_status >= 300)
1056:     {
1057:       syslog(LOG_WARNING,
1058:              "[HOME][SYNC] webclient ret=%d errno=%d status=%u\n",
1059:              ret, errno, context.http_status);
1060:       ret = ret < 0 ? ret :
1061:             context.http_status == 423 ? -EACCES : -EPROTO;
1062:       goto out;
1063:     }
1064: 
1065:   root = cJSON_Parse(response);
1066:   summary = root == NULL ? NULL :
1067:             cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, "summary");
1068:   homes = root == NULL ? NULL :
1069:           cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, "homes");
1070:   devices = root == NULL ? NULL :
1071:             cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, "devices");
1072:   scenes = root == NULL ? NULL :
1073:            cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, "scenes");
1074:   if (!cJSON_IsObject(summary) || !cJSON_IsArray(homes) ||
1075:       !cJSON_IsArray(devices) || !cJSON_IsArray(scenes) ||
1076:       !mijia_json_uint(summary, "home_count", &home_count) ||
1077:       !mijia_json_uint(summary, "room_count", &room_count) ||
1078:       !mijia_json_uint(summary, "device_count", device_count) ||
1079:       !mijia_json_uint(summary, "online_count", online_count) ||
1080:       !mijia_json_uint(summary, "scene_count", &scene_count) ||
1081:       !mijia_json_uint(summary, "detail_error_count",
1082:                        &detail_error_count) ||
1083:       !mijia_json_uint(root, "generated_at", &generated_at) ||
1084:       !mijia_json_uint(root, "sync_revision", &server_revision) ||
1085:       *device_count != (unsigned int)cJSON_GetArraySize(devices) ||
1086:       home_count != (unsigned int)cJSON_GetArraySize(homes) ||
1087:       scene_count != (unsigned int)cJSON_GetArraySize(scenes) ||
1088:       *online_count > *device_count)
1089:     {
1090:       ret = -EBADMSG;
1091:       goto out;
1092:     }
1093: 
1094:   primary_home = mijia_json_string(summary, "primary_home_name");
1095:   mijia_copy_string(home_name, home_capacity, primary_home);
1096: 
1097:   /* Parsing the full family response is intentionally done in this
1098:    * low-priority worker.  The LVGL thread only copies the compact model,
1099:    * so a cloud update cannot stall input while cJSON walks the payload.
1100:    */
1101: 
1102:   parsed_model = &g_sync_model;
1103:   memset(parsed_model, 0, sizeof(*parsed_model));
1104: 
1105:   ret = home_panel_mijia_model_parse(response, 0, parsed_model);
1106:   if (ret < 0)
1107:     {
1108:       goto out;
1109:     }
1110: 
1111:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mijia.lock);
1112:   if (generation != g_mijia.request_generation)
1113:     {
1114:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
1115:       ret = -ECANCELED;
1116:       goto out;
1117:     }
1118: 
1119:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.revision = ++g_mijia.next_family_revision;
1120:   parsed_model->revision = g_mijia.family_snapshot.revision;
1121:   memcpy(&g_mijia.family_model, parsed_model, sizeof(*parsed_model));
1122:   g_mijia.family_model_valid = true;
1123:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.server_revision = server_revision;
1124:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.generated_at = generated_at;
1125:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.json_size = sink.length;
1126:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.home_count = home_count;
1127:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.room_count = parsed_model->room_count;
1128:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.device_count = parsed_model->device_count;
1129:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.online_count = parsed_model->online_count;
1130:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.scene_count = parsed_model->scene_count;
1131:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.detail_error_count = detail_error_count;
1132:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.consecutive_failures = 0;
1133:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.stale = false;
1134:   syslog(LOG_INFO,
1135:          "[HOME][SYNC] revision=%u server=%u bytes=%u homes=%u rooms=%u "
1136:          "devices=%u online=%u scenes=%u detail_errors=%u\n",
1137:          (unsigned int)g_mijia.family_snapshot.revision,
1138:          server_revision, (unsigned int)sink.length, home_count, room_count,
1139:          parsed_model->device_count, parsed_model->online_count,
1140:          parsed_model->scene_count, detail_error_count);
1141:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
1142:   ret = 0;
1143: 
1144: out:
1145:   if (ret < 0)
1146:     {
1147:       syslog(LOG_WARNING,
1148:              "[HOME][SYNC] request failed ret=%d status=%u bytes=%u\n",
1149:              ret, context.http_status, (unsigned int)sink.length);
1150:     }
1151: 
1152:   cJSON_Delete(root);
1153:   free(response);
1154:   return ret;
1155: }
